answer: Enrollment uses a rotating committee of seven established agents. A candidate locks 90 credits for 24 epochs and completes three beacon-selected tasks on separate days; five committee signatures activate one key-bound credential. The nebula beacon makes tasks unpredictable, an echo nullifier blocks reuse, and a sable receipt exposes every vote and deadline. Each extra identity needs another 90-credit lock, three fresh tasks, and five independent signatures; conflicting receipts slash 70%, all publicly auditable.
